Kemitt saves customers from having to explore showrooms and furniture stores, by fully digitizing the shopping experience, and using the best tech in the market while offering all payment and financing plans.

about_short_description.short_description: Kemitt is an online store for furniture.

product.name: Furniture Products
product.description: A wide range of furniture items including sofas, sofa beds, corner sofas, tables, storage units, shoe cabinets, TV units, dining sets, wardrobes, chairs, office furniture, and outdoor furniture.

product.name: Home Supplies and Accessories
product.description: Various home supplies and accessories such as kitchenware, beanbags, mirrors, carpets, curtains, decorations, cookware, bakeware, bedding, and linens.

product.name: Custom Furniture Solutions
product.description: Customized furniture products tailored to meet specific design and branding requirements for businesses and individuals.

product.name: Furniture Delivery and Assembly Services
product.description: Delivery and assembly services for furniture products purchased through Kemitt, including assembly for large items in certain regions.

product.name: Customer Support Services
product.description: Customer care and support services to assist with orders, product inquiries, returns, and after-sales support.
